question: Which of the following has initiated the Village Defence Guards scheme to instil a sense of self protection and ensure the safety and security of villages and infrastructural installations in and around the villages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jammu and Kashmir** has initiated the **Village Defence Guards scheme**.
 
• The scheme aims to instil a sense of **self-protection** among the villagers and ensure the safety and security of villages and **infrastructural installations in and around the villages**.
 
• The Village Defence Guards are trained to** handle emergency situations** and provide immediate assistance in case of any threats to the community.
 
• This initiative is part of the broader efforts to **enhance security and empower local communities** in Jammu and Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Village Defence Guards scheme is a continuation of earlier measures to involve local communities in maintaining law and order in the region.
 
• Such initiatives are crucial for the** socio-economic development of the region**, ensuring that peace and stability are maintained.
 
• In addition to security, the scheme also aims to build trust between the local population and the authorities.
 
• The government provides necessary training and resources to the Village Defence Guards to effectively perform their duties.
